name: Lakeside house
description: Two-storey lakeside house, 12 x 8 m: the water side (+z, the asset front) is almost all floor-to-ceiling glazing under a deep flat roof overhang, with a full-width glass-railed balcony on the upper floor and a timber deck along the front on posts with steps down to the shore; white render below, light timber cladding above, a small-windowed land side with the back door. Enterable: living room and kitchen below, two bedrooms and a bathroom above, two stairs off the land-side corridor.
notes: Place with +z facing the lake: the glazed front, balcony and deck face the water; the back door (-z) faces the street.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
